summary: HealthStream filed an 8-K reporting a September 11, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement in which it issued 1,355,932 shares to WJRJJ Ventures, LLC at $29.50 per share for about $40.0 million, while CEO/Chairman Robert A. Frist, Jr. sold 144,068 shares to the same investor at $29.50 per share for about $4.25 million, totaling 1.5 million shares, closing September 14, 2026. The Audit Committee and disinterested directors approved the related-party transaction under the Related-Party Transactions Policy; the deal includes 12-month standstill and indemnification terms. Proceeds fund general corporate purposes and strategic initiatives. Watch for dilution and governance scrutiny.
